_about: Retrieval eval fixture. wikis: engine = search backend family observed live (default = MediaWiki DB search, unified = Fandom UnifiedSearch, cirrus = CirrusSearch/Elastica); builtin = entry mirrors src-tauri/src/wiki/games.rs (pinned by a Rust test) vs. a user-added wiki (wikis.json shape). questions: style ∈ entity|stat|howto|negation|typo|control|compare; source ∈ history (verbatim from a real history.json) | hand (author-written, player voice) | synthetic (LLM-generated from page content, quarantined in reports); gold = acceptable page titles (any match after redirect resolution, case-insensitive); trunc = terms the truncation probe locates in the gold page; fact = expected answer for the answer-level judge.
